name: blackraptor-council
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates: they judge the work and record a cited verdict, machine-checked as it is written. An executive advisory council convened through a challenge protocol (sourced evidence, confidence labels, counter-case, voice-of-customer, 'what you lose'). Most seats answer to C-suite names, and the chair runs the convening: coo (COO), chair (Chair/Chief of Staff), finance (CFO), revenue (CRO), people-org (CHRO), technology-strategy (CTO), ethics-governance (General Counsel), market-insight and gtm-strategy (the two CMO seats), plus pricing-strategy, fundraising-ir, and growth-engine. They are convened by the main-session council skill, with the shared product-manager (CPO, via the auto-installed blackraptor-core pack) as the product/strategy anchor and the final pricing decision. The chair closes the convening with one decision, and the COO covers ops-heavy asks. There is no CEO seat: you are the CEO. Ships the `council` skill: say 'convene the council' (or /council) to run the whole protocol.
